verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad set of APIs. These cover event ingestion (HTTP V2), event export, cohort list/export/upload, taxonomy CRUD for event types and properties, read-only JSON data from dashboard charts, and Experiment APIs for managing flags and experiments from scripts. A probe also confirmed a published OpenAPI spec and an official MCP server. However, nothing claims API parity with the UI, and several UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent: creating and editing charts and dashboards, session replay, heatmaps, guides and surveys, and the visual experiment editor. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity guarantee, write APIs for charts/dashboards/notebooks/spaces, API access to session replay, heatmaps and guides/surveys, and independent corroboration of API coverage.
